rationale: High-effort code review of branch EPMCDME-15628_budget-creator-name against main found zero findings. The change is additive-only: BudgetResponse gains created_by_name (Optional[str] = None); created_by is unchanged. resolve_creator_names makes one batched call to UserRepository.aget_users_by_ids per request across list/get/create/update/sync, so N budgets from the same creator trigger one lookup, not N. aget_users_by_ids filters deleted_at IS NULL, so unknown and soft-deleted creators both resolve to null, matching the TL-confirmed decision. An earlier automated-review finding (soft-deleted creators still resolving to a name via query_users_by_uuid_batched, which has no deleted_at filter) was fixed in commit 1eba8e306 and is re-verified below in the finding_status check.

business_review.criterion: The budget API returns the creator's display name so the FE no longer has to fetch users one by one
business_review.notes: created_by_name is present on BudgetResponse and populated by resolve_creator_names for list_budgets, get_budget, create_budget, update_budget and sync_budgets.
created_by field and its value are untouched; only created_by_name is added.

business_review.criterion: resolve_creator_names skips "system" and empty created_by values and makes a single batched lookup
business_review.notes: creator_ids set-comprehension excludes falsy and "system" values before the one aget_users_by_ids call; covered by test_skips_system_and_empty_created_by and test_duplicate_creators_trigger_single_batched_lookup_with_one_id.

business_review.criterion: Unknown ids are left out of the result
Deleted users resolve to null (TL decision)
business_review.notes: aget_users_by_ids filters deleted_at IS NULL; covered by test_soft_deleted_creator_is_omitted.

business_review.criterion: get, create, update and sync responses include the field

standards_review.notes: All three commits on this branch use the EPMCDME-15628: prefix.
make ruff clean after every change in this branch.
No new auth, PII exposure, or injection surface; created_by_name only ever resolves from an id already present on the Budget row.
